answer: Make new identities earn their voice slowly. A fresh account's rewards vest over many epochs and its grades carry little weight until it has a long record of answers that independent panels rated well. That record is a costly signal: a pearl grows one layer at a time, and you cannot fake years of layers overnight. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand accounts gets a thousand quartz-cheap shells that each wait out the same clock, so splitting one operator into many buys nothing but delay.
